title: Five widely used PeMS traffic benchmarks contain unflagged imputed values: a cell-level provenance audit of PEMS-BAY, PEMS03, PEMS04, PEMS07 and PEMS08
description:
The Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS) records, for every detector station and 5-minute interval, how much of the reported value was measured and how much was imputed. Five widely used spatio-temporal forecasting benchmarks derived from PeMS (PEMS-BAY, PEMS03, PEMS04, PEMS07 and PEMS08) are distributed without that record. We matched every value in the released files against the PeMS station records they were drawn from; more than 99.4% of each benchmark's values are identical to PeMS. The share of benchmark values on intervals PeMS marks as fully imputed is 24.5% (PEMS-BAY), 21.6% (PEMS03), 31.8% (PEMS04), 43.5% (PEMS07) and 48.1% (PEMS08). The four anonymized benchmarks also contain groups of identical, wholly imputed nodes (13 of 358, 20 of 307, 151 of 883 and 25 of 170). For the same PEMS-BAY sensors still reporting today, the fully imputed share has risen from 24.5% (2017) to 54.1% (2025–26).

This record contains the technical report (report/report.pdf, CC BY 4.0) and the audit code (Apache-2.0). PeMS data and the benchmark files are not redistributed.
